notes.title: Vol. 1 Development Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048836/628579828d7bd085dabfc4991c6c9ce05a5e739e.png
Thank you!

We appreciate all the feedback you guys have given us thus far. We've heard you all loud and clear about the issues in the demo and are looking to iron out those bugs before the first public release. Going forward it'd be a big help if you could submit any future suggestions, bugs, issues you have using the feedback form linked at the bottom of this post. Before you all stampede towards that form let me inform you of what we are already aware of.

Known Bugs
  Enemy Audio too loud
 Player can fall through level when pushed in bathrooms
 Optimization on certain hardware and FPS dips
 Door in first area can sometimes teleport player in floor
 Enemy aggro doesn't stop
 Enemy detection sometimes not working properly
Known Issues

 Players get stuck on train tracks (if this happens look upward, jump, then dash)
 Options menu needs more love (volume slider bugs, more options for accessibility)
 Pickup radius on ammo needs to be bigger
 Explosion radius needs to be bigger

Aside from working on these issues we have also have few features in the works to make each more impactful.

That's all we have for have now, but we hope that you'll all give the demo a few more runs to optimize your mayhem.

Oh and don't forget to
